            tests/, examples/, paper/, doc/, README, Makefile EXCLUDED
            fsst_duplicate (MT API) NEVER called from runners/fsst/ — single-thread fairness
            fsst_avx512.cpp vendored because libfsst.cpp references fsst_compressAVX512 /
              fsst_hasAVX512 unconditionally inside namespace libfsst {}. The AVX-512
              intrinsics inside fsst_avx512.cpp are gated by `__AVX512F__`; on M1/ARM the
              file compiles to the scalar no-op fallback and fsst_hasAVX512() returns
              false, so libfsst.cpp's runtime gate `if (simd && fsst_hasAVX512())` takes
              the scalar path. cpp + libfsst.cpp" file list
              was incomplete; this PROVENANCE captures the actual library file set.
local_patches:
            fsst_avx512.cpp (local patch): fsst_hasAVX512()
              now returns false when the environment variable FSST_DISABLE_AVX512 is
              set, on top of the upstream CPUID check. This lets the FSST runner force
              the scalar compression path on AVX-512 hardware (config {"simd":false},
              roster baseline `fsst_scalar`) so the "FSST with/without AVX-512" headline
              points are measured on the SAME machine — isolating AVX-512's effect to
              compression throughput, the only thing it accelerates (the decoder is
              scalar regardless). Upstream behaviour is unchanged when the env var is
              unset. SHA256SUMS below reflects the patched file.
reproducibility_caveat:
            cwida/fsst has no upstream release tags. The commit_sha above
            is the authoritative version designator; reproducibility relies
            on the SHA pin + the SHA256SUMS manifest below.
